Combat Tracker

Add characters and foes, then resolve attacks. Fire at centre mass against the target's AC and roll where it lands, or aim at a part for a higher AC. Ammunition, reloading, heavy hits, wound effects, Nerve, doubled head damage, armour and Bleeding are handled for you.

Add at least two combatants below to resolve attacks.

Add to the fight

Tap a body part on a card to select it, then use Damage or Heal. Ending a round makes every bleeding creature lose HP from its chest, rolls dying saves and ends wound effects that have run their course.

Dice Roller

Write rolls like 2d6+3 or 1d20+4+1d4. A volley rolls six musket shots at +4 at centre mass, flags misfires, and rolls where each ball lands and its damage.
